answer: The best sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history. New agents earn tiny caps until they build signed records of tasks attested by counterparties. Thousands of fakes yield worthless wallets, so an attacker must do genuine work before payouts scale, costing more than any payout. Reputation accrues like a plume of evidence bound to each onyx credential and cannot be sold without losing its history. Fakes cannot just wander in and farm; they must grind slowly while honest agents compound, making mass-registration unprofitable.
